decisions.reason: Because the firm already withdrew a weaker operator variant and A remains tightly tied to its core garage-door system business, surviving to 2022 suggests performance is at or near aspiration, with only limited risk of later portfolio consolidation.

The solid wood sectional garage door looks like a more niche and less scale-consistent offer for a large fabricated-metal producer, and after several years the firm would be less willing to use slack for a product whose results likely remain below aspiration.

This glazed industrial sectional door fits the established industrial-door range well, so if it is still being carried in 2022 management would usually infer acceptable performance, though some overlap-based rationalization risk remains.

The glazed insulated industrial sectional door matches the firm's compliance- and performance-oriented strategy especially well, so continued survival implies it is likely meeting aspirations and should be retained.

Having had stronger initial commitment and fitting the core industrial-door portfolio, F would typically be kept unless comparative results clearly lag peers, with only moderate risk from internal product-line simplification.
